character.name: Idle
character.prompt:
Pixel art top-down RPG character sprite, Pokémon Gen3 scale (chibi, 3-4 heads tall).

Character: young Filipino woman, market vendor, 1887 colonial Philippines.

Face/Hair: warm tan skin, dark brown hair pulled back neatly under a headscarf, soft
round face, gentle neutral expression, small dark eyes.

Headwear: cream/off-white headscarf/bandana wrapped fully around the head and tied at
the side, with small fabric ends visible.

Top: cream/off-white blouse (camisa) with short puffed sleeves, plain and simple, no
heavy trim.

Bottom: deep maroon/burgundy wrap skirt (patadyong-style) with subtle woven texture,
falling to mid-shin length.

Footwear: simple tan leather sandals.

Prop: carrying a round woven basket (bilao) filled with fruits (bananas, oranges, small
purple eggplants) held with both arms at waist/hip height.

Palette: cream, maroon/burgundy, tan skin, dark brown hair, warm neutral tones. Flat
top-down lighting, soft single-direction shadow, transparent background.

Animations: Idle (breathing loop) + Walk (loop), 8 directions each (S, SE, E, NE, N, NW,
W, SW). No other animation states.

Clean pixel edges, no anti-aliasing blur, small readable silhouette.
